name: dspilot-web
description: DSPilot 정적 뷰(wwwroot/app)용 Tailwind(stitch) CSS 빌드. CDN 대신 self-host 정적 CSS 생성(오프라인).

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i tailwind/stitch.input.css -o wwwroot/css/stitch.css --minify && tailwindcss -c tailwind.shell.config.js -i tailwind/shell.input.css -o wwwroot/css/stitch-shell.css --minify
